equivalence_note: F1 daily: target, actual interbank overnight cash rate (with high/low and volume), BBSW 1/3/6M, OIS 1/3/6M, T-notes; F2 daily AGS 2/3/5/10Y. Corridor known from A2.

es_rate.label: ES rate (rate paid on surplus ES balances) = target − 10 bp

overnight_repo_rate.label: Overnight standing-facility repo rate = target + 25 bp

overnight_minus_es_rate_bps.label: AONIA − ES rate (bps; distance from the floor, normal ≈ +10)

band_position.label: Position in the corridor (0 = ES rate floor, 1 = +25 ceiling; normal ≈ 0.29)

bbsw_minus_target_bps.label: BBSW 3M − cash rate target (bps; bank funding + expectations)

cash_market_dispersion_bps.label: Cash market dispersion: highest − lowest AONIA trade (bps)

target_minus_2y_bps.label: Cash rate target − AGS 2Y (bps; > 0 = market prices cuts)

tn_yield_minus_target_bps.label: Treasury Note tender yield − cash rate target (bp)
tn_yield_minus_target_bps.note: A6: layer-4 context (money-market pricing of the Commonwealth vs the target)

alerts.action_hint: ≥ +3 early flag; ≥ +5 for 3 sessions = STRESS; ≥ +15 = CRISIS (ceiling +25)
0.29 = at target; 1.0 = at the standing-facility ceiling
